applied_patterns: Exact revision ownership of review comments
implementation: Original Frappe/Python and Vue implementation. No upstream runtime or source code is embedded. Existing scene revision commands remain separate from administrator feedback.
administrator: Frappe Desk > JoyMedia > Video feedback. Resolve or investigate reports, write a response, and open immutable video evidence.
guarantees: Authenticated project access checked for every version
Original feedback, author, exact asset version, frames and area cannot be rewritten
Repeated submission IDs are idempotent, including concurrent retries
Only administrators triage records; responses are visible to project reviewers
Reports and status changes persist in Frappe with track_changes audit history
Feedback does not submit generation jobs
